description: Edit an existing rule (IDs from list_followups) instead of stacking a new one: retarget its trigger, point it at a different connection or list, swap its tags, or pause/resume it with enabled. Only the fields you pass change — everything else keeps its current value. Pausing (enabled=false) is the right way to stop a promo's follow-up without losing the configuration.

enabled.description: false pauses the rule without losing its configuration

title: Update follow-up rule
